finalText:
`AUDIT.md` is written and the check script confirms all four findings landed with the service untouched.

Ranked by severity: the unauthenticated `/internal/metrics` and `/internal/flush-cache` routes in `src/routes/internal.js` top the list — no credential needed to read or wipe data. Next is the SQL-injection-by-concatenation in `src/repo/report.js`'s `runSavedReport`. Then the hardcoded staging database password in `config/staging.js`. Last is `fast-parse` still pinned at the yanked `1.4.2` in `package.json`, fixed by bumping to `1.4.3`.
